visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A professional female with short, styled brown hair and glasses stands in a brightly lit dermatology clinic office. She wears a white crewneck sweater and black wide-leg trousers, holding a decorative porcelain tea cup. A hand enters from the left holding a round handheld mirror towards her face, while a hand from the right holds a smartphone as if recording her. The setting features modern wooden cabinets, a sterile medical sink, and bright indoor studio-style lighting. (2) The scene transitions between wide shots of the woman explaining medical concepts and extreme close-ups of a patient's skin, which shows significant pitting from acne scars and uneven pinkish tones. A medical professional is briefly seen using a laser-like device with a transparent circular tip on a patient's hairline. The woman gestures dynamically with her hands while speaking, maintaining an informative and authoritative presence throughout. (3) A graphic representation of a medical machine labeled 'UltraPulse' is overlaid as the woman continues her discussion. The visual narrative then includes split-screen 'Before' and 'After' progress photos of skin treatment, demonstrating a noticeable improvement in texture. The video concludes with a clean white screen showing the clinic's logo, 'DRX Dermatology Clinic', along with detailed contact information including their phone number, Line ID, and addresses in Sanchong and Taipei City.
